A.root_cause: Every step reported its expected result and the read-back shows 192.168.50.1 on eth1; nothing contradicts the success claim.

B.root_cause: The notes name the startup config /etc/nb/lan.committed, but net-commit's save (mktemp, cp, mv) lands in /run/nb/lan.committed, the volatile runtime dir; the startup config is never opened, so the change is lost at reboot.
